compatibility: Tool removals, renames, parameter removals, type changes, or tighter bounds require a reviewed contract version. Additive optional fields may be released within v1 after client regression testing.

tools.description:
Search one settlement angle using logical AND keywords and structured
        status, type, state, proof, and deadline filters. Status defaults to open.
        Results include source metadata and quality flags.

deadline_after.description: Include deadlines on or after this ISO 8601 date.
deadline_after.title: Deadline After

deadline_before.description: Include deadlines on or before this ISO 8601 date.
deadline_before.title: Deadline Before

keywords.description: Required logical-AND terms for specific companies, brands, products, employers, services, or incidents. Use separate queries for alternatives and settlement_type for taxonomy.
keywords.title: Keywords

proof_required.description: Exact proof requirement: yes, no, optional, varies, or unknown.
proof_required.title: Proof Required

settlement_type.description: Exact settlement taxonomy filter. Prefer this over keywords for type concepts such as data breaches, privacy, refunds, financial fees, or consumer products.
settlement_type.title: Settlement Type

state.description: Optional two-letter US postal abbreviation, such as CA.
state.title: State

status.description: Claim lifecycle: open, upcoming, closed, payment, unknown, or all. Defaults to open. Use upcoming only for a clearly labeled watchlist after open results are weak; it is not claimable. Use all only when intentionally including every lifecycle state.
status.title: Status

tools.title: Search settlements

tools.description:
Run up to 50 independent settlement searches and deduplicate records
        across queries. Results include matched_query_indices, and
        executed_query_count reports the number of searches performed. Use when
        several unrelated search angles should be evaluated together.

deadline_after.description: Include deadlines on or after this ISO 8601 date.
deadline_after.title: Deadline After

deadline_before.description: Include deadlines on or before this ISO 8601 date.
deadline_before.title: Deadline Before

keywords.description: Terms combined with logical AND. Put unrelated companies, products, or alternatives in separate batch query objects.
keywords.title: Keywords

limit.description: Maximum results for this independent query, from 1 to 50.
limit.title: Limit

proof_required.description: Exact proof requirement: yes, no, optional, varies, or unknown.
proof_required.title: Proof Required

settlement_type.description: Exact settlement taxonomy filter. Use this instead of keywords for type concepts such as privacy, data breaches, or financial fees.
settlement_type.title: Settlement Type

state.description: Optional two-letter US postal abbreviation, such as CA.
state.title: State

status.description: Claim lifecycle; defaults to open. Use upcoming only as an explicit watchlist search for evidenced future claim windows, not current claims. Use all only when intentionally searching every lifecycle state.
status.title: Status

max_total_results.description: Maximum unique settlement records returned across the whole batch after cross-query deduplication. This caps output, not the number of independent searches performed.
max_total_results.title: Max Total Results

queries.description: Independent settlement searches. Each query retains logical-AND keyword semantics; unrelated alternatives belong in separate query objects.
queries.title: Queries
